_meta.note: Materials inputs and environmental footprint of the chip pipeline. Curated from public sources — CSET/ETO Supply Chain Explorer's input taxonomy (chipexplorer.eto.tech), company ESG disclosures, trade press. Editorial layer; verify figures before citing.
sources: CSET Emerging Technology Observatory — Supply Chain Explorer (input/provider taxonomy)
Company ESG reports (TSMC, Samsung, SK Hynix water/energy disclosures)
Public reporting on Ga/Ge/rare-earth export controls and PFAS regulation

inputs.name: Polysilicon → monocrystalline ingots
inputs.note: Extremely energy-intensive refining; ingot pulling concentrated in Japan (Shin-Etsu, SUMCO)

inputs.name: Photoresists (ArF/EUV)
inputs.note: Japanese near-monopoly; EUV resists among the most supply-concentrated chemicals on earth

inputs.name: Specialty & bulk gases (Ne, He, F-compounds, NF3)
inputs.note: Neon supply shocked by the Ukraine war (2022 price spikes); high-GWP fluorinated gases face abatement mandates

inputs.name: Ultra-pure quartz & EUV mask blanks
inputs.note: Spruce Pine (US) quartz for crucibles; defect-free mask blanks are a Hoya/AGC duopoly

inputs.name: Gallium, germanium, rare earths
inputs.note: Chinese production dominance; export controls since 2023 — the counter-control lever

inputs.name: CMP slurries, filters, ultra-pure chemicals delivery
Ultra-pure water
inputs.note: A leading-edge fab uses on the order of 100–200k tons/day; Taiwan's 2021 drought forced water trucking — climate risk is fab risk

inputs.name: Electricity
inputs.note: TSMC alone consumes a high-single-digit share of Taiwan's power, rising with each EUV node; fab decarbonization = grid decarbonization

inputs.name: PFAS ('forever chemicals')
inputs.note: Pervasive in litho/etch/cooling; tightening EU/US regulation and 3M's exit from PFAS manufacture ripple through the chemical chain

inputs.name: EUV consumables (tin, collector optics, CO2 lasers)
inputs.note: Tin-droplet plasma sources; collector mirror refurbishment loops back to ASML/Zeiss

inputs.name: Precision optics & Zerodur-class glass
inputs.note: Zeiss SMT (private, DE) is the unlisted chokepoint inside ASML's chokepoint
